claims.statement: For every eligible ordinary tree T and fixed favorable-leaf selector F, with k=p-1, Q the total marked independent k-set count, M the sum of open-neighborhood sizes over those marked sets, and C the per-tag count of multiply marked independent (k+1)-sets, the complete aggregate satisfies kS=(|V(T)|-2p)Q-M-C. In particular S<=0 whenever |V(T)|<=2p.
claims.scope: Exact algebraic reduction under the primary contract definitions; the conclusion S<=0 is asserted only in the subcase |V(T)|<=2p. No claim is made for |V(T)|>2p.
claims.reason: The addability incidence count is kU+C, each marked k-set has (n-2)-k-|N_H(A)| addable vertices, and S=U-Q. Substitution gives the formula. Nonnegativity of M and C proves the stated order subcase. The remaining universal compensation inequality is open in this work.

limitations: The required compensation M+C>=(|V(T)|-2p)Q is not established when |V(T)|>2p.
No universal flat or current-rank addability budget is proved or refuted.
No exact counterexample search, exhaustive census, external literature search, or formal verification was performed.
